task: Read the event registration details from google_form.pdf and create a confirmation letter as a new docx file named confirmation_bob.docx. The letter should include all the information from the form in a formal confirmation format, including the attendee's name, email, phone number, the event date, and the comment provided. Ensure that the document confirms the registration and restates all provided details clearly.
query_sentence: Process the registration form information from google_form.pdf and prepare a confirmation letter in a new docx file.

ground_truth_memory.info: Create a new docx file named confirmation_bob.docx.
The confirmation letter should formally confirm the registration for the event.
Include the following details from the registration form: Name (Bob), Email (Bob3@gmail.com), Phone Number (123-456-7890), Event Date (2024-06-25), and Comments (Looking forward to the event!).
Ensure the letter restates all provided information from the form and presents them clearly in the confirmation docx file.
